pages.title: A companion for your magic
text: A **familiar** is a creature bonded to you. It follows you, waits where you tell it and never despawns, and each kind has a gift of its own ([what familiars do](familiar_gifts)).

Give it a voice at a **Resonance Totem** and it becomes part of your magic: Spirit Charms and Spiritgear of that voice cost less, and its songs and rites grow stronger, while it is within **16 blocks** of you.
Magic works without a familiar. A familiar makes it stronger.

pages.title: Who can be bonded
text: - **Gentle beasts**: the Dawn Stag and Lantern Fox of forests, the Mossback of swamps, and the grazers, hoppers and moths of every March biome. Anyone can bond them.
- **Six remnants**, once their tribe calls you **Voice** (800 standing): Shardback, Rift Hound, Cinder Imp, Storm Moth, Mourning Bell and Echo Weaver. The next page says which tribe speaks for which.
Ashbound, Rootbound, Reed Stalkers and Hollow Sentinels never answer, and neither do bosses, goblins, trolls or the March's other hostiles. The young cannot be bonded.
**Sneak and look** at a creature to see whether it can be bonded and what it needs. A Ley Lens sneak-used on it says the same.
See [standing](standing) for how to earn it.
